services.name: Youth Program Details
services.desc: FREE beginner friendly program. Fall is the perfect time to explore our parks with binoculars and view birds. Seasonal migrations can make this an exciting time for both novice and experienced birders to sight birds along our greenways. Guests are encouraged to dress comfortably and bring binoculars if they have them. Rangers have a couple of extra pairs to share if needed. Dress for the weather forecast and wear sturdy walking shoes when participating in the programs! Explore what you find curious in the natural world through enriching discussion and receive ranger led guidance on how to document your discoveries through illustration and writing. This program will meet quarterly to explore

services.name: Afterschool Program
services.desc: The City of Columbia Parks and Recreation Department’s After-School Program begins on Thursday, August 6, for youth ages 5-12. Children will have the opportunity to participate in supervised recreation, academic enrichment, sports, arts and crafts, games, and other engaging activities in a safe and fun environment. The program operates Monday through Friday from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. during the school year. Participants must be 5-12 years old as of September 1, 2025, to enroll. The cost of the program is $40 per child, per week. Snacks will be provided. Special activities may require an additional fee.
